entities.name: Altair of Coloni
entities.description: Planeswalker of white magic from the Plains of Coloni on Corondor, member of the council of mages at Minorad.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Appeared at the Minorad gathering with the Golgothian Sylex and cursed Altair.

entities.name: Caliphear
entities.description: Nightmare to whom Altair became slave for ten years.

entities.name: Coldraith
entities.description: Wizard destroyed by Altair and Caliphear who accidentally removed Ravidel's curse.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact Ravidel threatened the mages with.

entities.name: Dueling Chasm of Golthonor
entities.description: Site of the battle with Ravidel.

entities.name: Minorad
entities.description: Place where the council of mages gathered.

events.summary: Ravidel threatens the Minorad mages with the Golgothian Sylex; Altair agrees not to interfere but Ravidel curses him anyway.
events.quote: Ravidel cast a spell anyway preventing him from using his planeswalker powers

events.summary: Altair and Caliphear destroy the wizard Coldraith, who accidentally removed Ravidel's curse.
events.quote: he and Caliphear the Nightmare destroyed the wizard Coldraith

events.summary: To repay Caliphear, Altair agrees to be her slave for ten years.
events.quote: he agreed to be her slave for ten years

events.summary: Altair joins Jared Carthalion and Kristina of the Woods against Ravidel.
events.quote: he joined Jared Carthalion and Kristina of the Woods in opposing Ravidel

events.summary: Altair battles Ravidel at the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor and is reportedly killed.

relations.note: Agreed to be her slave for ten years.
relations.quote: he agreed to be her slave for ten years
he joined Jared Carthalion and Kristina of the Woods in opposing Ravidel
